🔥 The fire settles. Owen has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Speedbump — I put it down today." "It doesn't move. It hasn't moved in an hour. Its head is suddenly somewhere else." "It seals itself. The shell clicks shut — nearly invulnerable. Wait it out, or flip it." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Aroha mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Sari mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

🔥 The fire settles. Ernestine has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Living Wire — I put it down today." "The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift." "The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Stig says "The fire feels smaller now." Owen asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
